modules.title: 上传后，任务为什么先排队再完成
入队成功和任务完成不是同一件事

items.title: 先解决请求卡住的问题
items.text: 如果上传请求直接做转码，用户只能一直等待，转码失败还会表现成整次上传失败；入队让接口先接收任务并返回任务 ID。

items.title: 让状态反馈回来
items.text: 后续处理者取出任务并更新排队、处理中、完成或失败状态，页面用任务 ID 查询这些结果；失败时可以按系统规则重试或提示用户。

items.title: 改善是可观察的
items.text: 上传请求能较快结束，用户能看到任务状态变化，失败也能定位到任务；但入队本身不保证 FIFO 顺序，也不保证恰好一次处理。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 入队不是完成通知，也不是永久保存和严格顺序的承诺。具体队列必须看自己的排序规则、容量和失败处理方式；只看到任务 ID，不能把状态直接判为完成。

lessonPractice.title: 上传接口已经返回任务 ID，但转码还没结束。页面应该把这次结果显示成什么？

options.label: 显示已入队或处理中，并用任务 ID 查询后续状态
options.feedback: 对。任务 ID 说明可以追踪这项工作，但入队成功不代表转码结果已经产生。

options.label: 直接显示转码完成，因为任务已经成功写入队列
options.feedback: 写入队列只表示任务已经被接收；消费者何时开始处理、最终是否成功，都要另行确认。

options.label: 让上传请求一直等到转码结束，再返回任务 ID
options.feedback: 这会把耗时处理重新塞回上传请求，失去入队后立即返回的好处，也更容易超时。

en.title: The upload API returned a task ID, but transcoding is not finished. What should the page show?

options.label: Show queued or processing, and use the task ID to check later status
options.feedback: Correct. The task ID makes the work trackable, but enqueueing does not mean transcoding has finished.

options.label: Show completed because the task was successfully written to the queue
options.feedback: Writing to the queue only means the task was accepted. You still need to check when processing starts and whether it succeeds.

options.label: Keep the upload request open until transcoding finishes, then return the task ID
options.feedback: That puts the long operation back inside the upload request, making timeouts more likely.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 把上传后的转码任务入队，接口先返回可追踪的任务 ID；页面显示已入队、处理中、完成和失败状态。请验证任务确实进入队列、失败能反馈到状态查询，并确认入队成功不会被误显示成转码完成。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Enqueue the transcoding task after upload and return a trackable task ID immediately. Show queued, processing, completed, and failed states. Verify that the task enters the queue, failures reach status lookup, and enqueue success is not shown as transcoding completion.

learning.assumes: You have seen a page show queued work or completion later.
learning.outcome: You can distinguish queue acceptance from task completion and avoid assuming an order or exactly-once processing.

modules.title: Why work is queued before it finishes after an upload
Queue acceptance is not task completion

items.title: Avoid blocking the request
items.text: If the upload request performs transcoding directly, the user waits and a processing failure can look like an upload failure. Enqueueing accepts the task and returns its ID first.

items.title: Bring status back
items.text: A later processor updates queued, processing, completed, or failed state. The page looks up those results with the task ID; failures can be retried or reported under the system rules.

items.title: Improvement is observable
items.text: The upload request finishes sooner, status changes are visible, and failures are tied to a task. Enqueueing still does not promise FIFO order or exactly-once processing.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: Enqueueing is not a completion notification, permanent storage, or a strict ordering promise. Check the queue's ordering, capacity, and failure rules before making those assumptions.
